verdict.rationale: E2B runs agent code in isolated Firecracker microVMs in the cloud, so the agent's tools execute there rather than on your machine or server. Host secrets and credentials therefore sit outside the code's reach by design (e2b-docs-43, e2b-docs-44, e2b-gh-3). Outbound network allow and deny lists add exfiltration control (e2b-docs-10). missing for 10: explicit documentation of secret/credential isolation or a secret-injection mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation boundary.
